sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASES: https://answercoderequest.bandcamp.com/album/halo — all ten tracks from Answer Code Request's 2026-06-26 album screened; Refraction retained because the official exact-track album notes describe fractured downtempo micro beats, angular breakbeat fractals and finely detailed drum sequences that continually rearrange.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://30drecords.bandcamp.com/album/eines-ep-30deyes-006 — all four tracks from ABSIS's 2026-01-29 EP screened; Arada retained as the opening long-form specimen from a release explicitly built from fractured beats, broken rhythms and thick textures.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://noidrecords.bandcamp.com/album/out-of-boundaries — all four tracks from Bogotá producer Caotical Disordah's 2026-03-13 EP screened; EX01 retained as a concise specimen from a release explicitly combining broken rhythms, heavy bass and experimental texture.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://mechatronica.bandcamp.com/album/disrupted-dialect — all six tracks from Second Storey's 2023-08-25 EP screened; Cold Snap retained from a release framed around speedy electro, bass music, IDM, bleeped machine funk, spotless broken rhythms and fractured forms.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: bounded 2026 Delsin, Ilian Tape, Short Span, Refraction, Saraw and independent-label result pages were screened. Picture's 2026 material was excluded because the identified exact track was explicitly unavailable on Spotify; recent Outer Orbit, Soma, Seismic, Sublunar, Sun People, OODA and QEONE lanes were not repeated.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 39 named tracks across ten current, adjacent and catalogue release/result windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded.
The two protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

Other tracks from the four selected releases were screened but ranked below the four leads for exact-track or representative structural relevance; no artist, label, texture, novelty or role quota was used.

No lead was promoted for recency, artist reputation, genre, title, supplied Spotify identity or assumed BPM. Energy, density, bodily effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Answer Code Request — Refraction: current exact-track label notes describe fractured downtempo micro beats, angular breakbeat fractals and drum sequences continually forming new arrangements; a retailer reports 93 BPM, which is metadata evidence only.

2. ABSIS — Arada: emerging 2026 opening track with an exact public Spotify identity; release-level notes describe fractured beats, broken rhythms and thick textures, but do not distinguish Arada's own behaviour.

3. Caotical Disordah — EX01: emerging Bogotá release specimen from an EP explicitly joining broken rhythms, heavy bass and experimental textures; exact identity and track-specific behaviour require resolution.

4. Second Storey — Cold Snap: overlooked 2023 catalogue specimen from a release explicitly joining speedy electro, bass, IDM, machine funk and spotless broken rhythms; exact identity and track-specific behaviour require resolution.
